title: Rukkha
text: 2. Seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye keci Asurānam rukkhā Cittapāṭali tesam aggam akkhāyati || evam eva kho bhikkhave ye keci bodhapakkhikā dhammā paññindriyaṃ tesam aggam akkhāyati yad idam bodhāya || || 3. Katame ca bhikkhave bodhapakkhikā dhammā || Saddhindriyam bhikkhave- -tam bodhāya saṃvattati || pa [pe] || paññindriyaṃ- -tam bodhāya saṃvattati || || Seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye keci asurānam rukkhā Cittapāṭali tesam aggam akkhāyati || evam eva- -paññindriyaṃ tesam aggam akkhāyati yad idam bodhāyā ti || ||
